name: oogaboogaland-worker
description: Serves the built page and runs GitHub sign-in on Cloudflare Workers + D1

scripts.dev: npm --prefix .. run build:site && wrangler dev --config ../wrangler.staging.jsonc --port 8787 --local-upstream localhost:8787
scripts.deploy:staging: npm --prefix .. run build:site && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config ../wrangler.staging.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config ../wrangler.staging.jsonc
scripts.deploy:production: npm --prefix .. run build:site && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config ../wrangler.production.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config ../wrangler.production.jsonc
